procedural_matters: GER 11 was represented by Richard SCHULTHEIS (helm).
SUI 77 was represented by Sébastien SCHNEITER (helm).
Ryan SEATON (coach of GER 11) and Arno de PLANTA (crew of SUI 77) attended the hearing as an observer.
SUI 77 provided tracking and video evidence.
The International Jury provided tracking evidence.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 5 knots of wind and flat water.
SUI 77 rounded gate mark 2p and was sailing close-hauled on port tack.
GER 11 was sailing on the run on starboard tack, on the starboard layline to mark 2p and on a converging course with SUI 77.
When the boats were approximately 2 boat lengths apart, SUI 77 luffed by about 20º.
SUI 77 passed approximately 30 cm to windward of GER 11.
conclusions: By luffing, SUI 77 on port tack kept clear of GER 11 on starboard tack, as required by RRS 10.
